data.title: Request to confirm commissioning of a basement moisture survey
data.summary: Musterhausen Bausachverständige GbR replies to your enquiry about dampness in your basement and asks you to confirm, by the deadline shown, whether they should go ahead and prepare the survey report (Gutachten); the corresponding offer (Angebot) is enclosed. Letter reference: SV-26-311.
data.explanation: This letter is a reply to your inquiry about moisture in your cellar. The company proposes a flat-fee on-site visit and written report; the price is in the enclosed offer. They ask you to tell them by the deadline shown (counted as working days from the letter's date, where Saturdays count but Sundays and public holidays do not) whether you want them to proceed. No payment is due yet. The letter does not say what happens if you miss the deadline, but it is sensible to reply in time so the offer stays valid. Consider the enclosed offer's price before deciding; no professional advice is required just to respond.
